这一集围绕卢克的生日派对展开。派对一开始像是父母之间的一场竞争，最后却以全家人一起去医院收场。

菲尔和克莱尔觉得有些内疚，因为卢克平时很少主动要求什么，所以他们决定给他办一场最棒的生日派对。克莱尔准备了一个手工区，让孩子们装饰用来放梳子的皮套。菲尔觉得这个主意无聊透了，于是在没有告诉她的情况下，租来了攀岩墙、滑索，还有其他大型游乐设施，摆满了后院。

其他家人也带来了自己的想法。杰给卢克买了一把弩，尽管所有人都认为卢克大概不适合碰这种东西。他们还请来一位带着爬行动物和昆虫的表演者。卡梅隆想打扮成“菲兹博”来参加派对，那是他多年前创造的一个小丑角色。菲尔说卢克害怕小丑，但真相是，真正怕小丑的人其实是菲尔自己。

米切尔让卡梅隆别穿那套服装，但卡梅隆怎么都放不下这个念头。去派对的路上，米切尔和一个开车撞到他的粗鲁司机吵了起来。米切尔想替自己出头，却很快就失去了底气。接着，卡梅隆穿着菲兹博的服装出现，把那个男人吓得立刻道歉。米切尔一开始觉得这套小丑装很丢人，却不得不承认，菲兹博有时确实很有用。

与此同时，曼尼想给学校里一个叫比安卡的女孩留下好印象。杰告诉他，女孩喜欢幽默的男生，于是曼尼试着对她讲了几个笑话，结果每一个都很失败。格洛丽亚告诉他，他不需要耍什么技巧，只要做回那个温柔、自然的自己就好。曼尼听取了建议，不过他看起来仍然下定决心，要用某种方式打动她。

到了派对上，几乎所有事情同时开始失控。海莉看到迪伦和那位带爬行动物的女人聊了太久，开始吃醋。一只有毒的蝎子逃了出来，所有人陷入恐慌，杰还不小心射出了弩箭。曼尼冲进混乱中去救比安卡的狗，希望证明自己是个真正敢于行动的人。

随后，卢克踩到克莱尔手工区散落的珠子，滑倒摔断了手臂。菲尔带来了那么多危险的大型设施，最后真正让卢克受伤的，却偏偏是那个没人愿意玩的安静活动。

到了医院，菲尔和克莱尔非常自责，为毁掉他的生日向他道歉。可卢克却说，这是他度过的最好的一次生日。他终于有了一个石膏，全家人都围在身边，而且每个人都想在上面签名。派对虽然是一场灾难，卢克却开心得不得了。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about Luke’s birthday party, which starts as a competition between his parents and ends with the whole family at the hospital.

Phil and Claire feel guilty because Luke doesn’t ask for much, so they decide to give him the best party they can. Claire plans a craft table where the children can decorate leather holders for their combs. Phil thinks that sounds incredibly boring, so without telling her, he rents a rock-climbing wall, a zip line, and other big attractions for the backyard.

The rest of the family brings their own ideas. Jay buys Luke a crossbow, even though everyone agrees that Luke probably shouldn’t be trusted with one. They also hire a woman to bring reptiles and insects. Cameron wants to come as Fizbo, the clown character he created years ago. Phil says Luke hates clowns, but the truth is that Phil is the one who’s terrified of them.

Mitchell asks Cameron not to wear the costume, but Cameron can’t let the idea go. On the way to the party, Mitchell gets into an argument with a rude driver who bumped him with his car. Mitchell tries to stand up for himself but quickly loses his confidence. Then Cameron appears dressed as Fizbo and scares the man into apologizing. Mitchell is embarrassed by the clown costume at first, but he has to admit that Fizbo can be useful.

Meanwhile, Manny wants to impress a girl from school named Bianca. Jay tells him that girls like funny guys, so Manny tries a few jokes on her. They all go badly. Gloria tells him he doesn’t need tricks and should just be his sweet, natural self. Manny takes that advice, although he still seems determined to impress her somehow.

At the party, almost everything starts going wrong at once. Haley becomes jealous when Dylan spends too much time talking to the woman with the reptiles. A poisonous scorpion gets loose, everyone panics, and Jay accidentally fires the crossbow. Manny runs into the chaos to save Bianca’s dog, hoping to prove that he’s a man of action.

Then Luke slips on some beads from Claire’s craft table and breaks his arm. After all the dangerous attractions Phil brought in, the thing that actually hurts him comes from the quiet activity nobody wanted to try.

At the hospital, Phil and Claire feel terrible and apologize for ruining the day. Luke, however, says it was the best birthday he’s ever had. He finally has a cast, the whole family is around him, and everyone wants to sign it. The party is a disaster, but Luke couldn’t be happier.
